results.title: Euphoria
results.overview: A young woman and her family seek justice after she is raped by a group of young men who come from powerful and influential backgrounds.

results.title: Hugo 24
results.overview: Hugo is 23 and still hasn't grown up. On the eve of his 24th birthday, he faces adulthood: he's unemployed, but goes to an interview at a real estate agency, a dream job that would allow him to wear a suit, something that reminds him of his absent father. He carries a deep fear of abandonment: his mother is in prison, his girlfriend is leaving, and his family is falling apart. When his landlord threatens to evict him in 24 hours, he begins a race against time that will mark his definitive step into adulthood.

results.title: Free at Heart
results.overview: Sebastian's (16) sheltered small-town life changes suddenly when his family takes in 15-year-old Kolja, supposedly the son of his father's recently deceased girlfriend. In addition to his little sister, another teenager now lives with them.  Although the two boys are strangers to each other at first, they begin to open up to each other more and more and discover that they are biological brothers. The relationship of trust with his parents breaks down and when Sebastian and Kolja become closer than they expected, Sebastian's life is suddenly turned upside down, as he has found not only a soul mate in his new brother, but also a real, first love. Overwhelmed by their feelings, the two hide their relationship, but when the secret, incestuous relationship is discovered, the family breaks out of the social structure of the small town and comes into conflict with societal norms. Everything that follows is a rollercoaster of emotions.

results.title: Santo António - Lisbon Love
results.original_title: Santo António - O Casamenteiro de Lisboa
results.overview: Lisbon's traditional Saint Anthony's Weddings have hit rock bottom. At least, that's what Stardust, a major French multinational poised to take over the event, believes. Carmo and Valentim, two Lisbon City Hall employees who have spent more than 25 years organizing the celebrations, are given a harsh ultimatum: reinvent the event and turn it into a modern success, or lose their jobs. Directed by the filmmaker behind The Gilded Cage, Saint Anthony is a vibrant comedy and a heartfelt love letter to Lisbon. A celebration of human connection, identity, and cultural resilience in an increasingly globalized world.

results.title: The Corpse 2
results.overview: Minh Như returns to her family’s dye workshop after years of exile. There, she confronts terrifying supernatural phenomena and uncovers the brutal truth behind her mother’s death and a blood-soaked pact from the past.

results.title: The Giant Falls
results.overview: Follows Boris, a charismatic tour guide who unexpectedly reunites with his estranged father Julián. Their tense and emotional encounters explore past wounds and the possibility of forgiveness.

results.title: Resonance
results.overview: When archaeologist Clara Hartley discovers her family's century-old secret to manipulate time, she must confront her estranged past and an inter-dimensional threat to save her daughter's future and the fabric of reality itself.

results.title: Nickels
results.overview: A successful entrepreneur and family man is involved in a bike accident involving his neighbor's son, triggering memories of his older brother's tragic death 30 years earlier.

results.title: The Outer Threat
results.overview: After making a groundbreaking extraterrestrial discovery, astrophysicists Daniel and Michelle are forced to flee from home with their family — pursued through the countryside by a relentless and anonymous assailant. As their flight unfolds, the line between cosmic revelation and human paranoia blurs, leading to a tense and emotional confrontation that challenges the boundaries of understanding, science, and survival.

results.title: Block 10
results.overview: In early 1943, at the Auschwitz main camp, hundreds of Jewish women are confined in cramped quarters in BLOCK 10, which is separated from the rest of the camp grounds. Nazi doctors subject them to the most painful methods of forced sterilization. Prisoner doctors are forced to collaborate. The Jewish gynecologist Dr. Maximilian Samuel is blackmailed with the gassing of his 20-year-old daughter if he refuses to participate in the brutal experiments. Caught in this moral dilemma, he seeks his own path.

results.title: Nekai Walks
results.overview: At 16, Nekai Foster was shot while walking home in Toronto's Jane and Finch neighbourhood. His journey of survival and recovery—defying all medical odds as he relearns to walk—exposes how gun violence shapes bodies, families and communities.

results.title: Still Afloat
results.overview: José Antonio, 89, is losing his memory. Although his family forbids him from doing so, he convinces his friend Mindo to go out fishing on the boat. Together, they are left adrift at sea, forcing them to confront old age and the passing of time.

results.title: The Nice Ones
results.overview: When Kate joins her boyfriend’s friends at a remote countryside retreat, old wounds resurface as strange lights appear in the sky. As unease grows, members of the group begin to change—becoming unnervingly calm, kind, and “nice.” Dismissed as unstable, Kate struggles to convince the others something is wrong before the force behind it spreads.

results.title: I Won't Die for Love
results.overview: At 18, Claudia doesn't want to be a hero. Her mother's illness erupts like a silent storm, forcing a redefinition of roles in a family long estranged. Torn between the duty to care for her mother and the desire to live like any other girl her age, Claudia searches for a way to navigate this new reality, which will transform the bonds between the entire family.

results.title: Tum Mere Ho
results.overview: Tum Mere Ho is a heartfelt romance starring Gurmeet Choudhary and Isha Malviya, exploring love, emotions, and the unexpected turns that bring two hearts together.

results.title: The Parting
results.overview: A 9-year-old girl gains control amidst family chaos by striving for her hair's perfect parting and pigtails, becoming self-reliant despite emotional turmoil.

results.title: Kyojo: Reunion
results.overview: Kyojo is a school that trains future police officers. In its closed room, where unqualified students are weeded out, students with dreams, hopes, and secrets face off against the strict instructor, Kimichi Kazama, who can see through even the smallest lies. This is the first of a two-part film adaptation of the TV drama series "Kyojo."

results.title: Konspirasi
results.overview: An elite team is deployed to seize a hidden server containing a list of corrupt politicians and offshore financial transactions. Led by Adli and his team, the covert mission turns into a trap when some of the data leaks to the media and the dark web, triggering a national political crisis. As public trust begins to erode and suspicions arise about internal traitors, the team uncovers clues pointing to a cyber expert and a renowned hacker. What starts as a secret operation soon develops into a dangerous conspiracy involving a power struggle in politics, large-scale cyberattacks, and foreign interference aiming to destabilise the country.

results.title: Deja Vu
results.overview: When a solitary artist begins experiencing increasingly vivid dreams and waking memories of a woman he's never met, his search for answers leads him to another man haunted by the same impossible relationship.
